R19 rendered: the capture of a page as a visitor saw it: the renderer was asked and the document is the rendered one beside its shell; control: a plain capture keeps the shell and asks no renderer; a world with no renderer refuses the render

R19 renderPending: a render still being made is left pending with its session, the open captures list it; released, 'Finish it' answers the visitor copy and the session leaves the list; a failed render is refused RENDER_FAILED and files nothing

R19 renderPending (alarm): the first capture filed under a project, released, the store's alarm finishes the render and the delivery files the visitor copy as a second document, and the session leaves the list; control: with no delivery nothing is filed

R19 unfinished: a capture left with its supporting files outstanding: the platform stops the call, the open captures list the session, and each 'Finish it' fetches more until none is owed; control: a plain capture of the same page keeps no session; a ceiling past the pictures leaves none

R19 partedAddress: the alarm's fetch of a file over what the call reads holds the capture in parts, the record's image lists them in order; control: acquire alone answers no document (the source is owed), and a file the call reads whole is no recipe state

R17 R19 followed: a world made with follow: true follows a promotion with its reading: a file read at once is read, a file over the inline ceiling stands by its job row and the promotion says reading_pending until the alarm reads it; controls: a document that brings its own reading is not followed, and without follow nothing follows

R17 R19 delivered (follow): the alarm's delivery promotes through the door, so a world that follows reads a small file at once and leaves a file over the inline ceiling to its job row until the alarm reads it; control: a world that does not follow has no reading for the small file either
R19 recipes.holdAt: a page captured at its address is filed at collected and `heldat` finds it by the address; control: another address is not held

R19 recipes.newerCapture: a changed source monitored raises an open notice for the question citing it and the queue's finding; keep and adopt answer it; control: a question citing an unchanged page raises none
R19 recipes.connection: two captures naming one ordinance form a connection with a mention; the member chooses it and a progression threads both; control: the entity of one capture alone has none
R19 recipes.partialPdf: the reading holds pages 0 and 2 and names page 1 unread; the member's transcription mints it; control: the default PDF reads no page
R19 recipes.unmatchedPerson: one row of the directory matches an entity and five names stay unresolved; her testimony resolves one and the identity claim is made; control: without testimony no claim
R19 recipes.attested: with the authority and the archive up the attestation carries both; asked again with the network changed it answers each case; control: neither is NO_ATTESTATION
R19 recipes.paperFile: a route that cannot be shown is looked at and found indeterminate, marked; control: a held page's route is present
R19 recipes.unretirable: retiring a copy never vouched for is refused ILLEGAL_TRANSITION naming it; control: the refusal is the owner's, not the door's
R16: signIn({admin: true}) makes an active administrator by the real acts, the third and the fourth too (every administrator endorses); the second is refused by nothing
R16: signIn answers the member's password: the claim's for the founder, the chosen one for any other, and it is the one that signs in again
R19: recipes.queue({obligations}) makes the founder's queue hold that many obligations by real acts; findings or conditions are refused naming them
R19 recipes.readings: a question holds one reading in each of the states accepted, considering, rejected and suggested; control: a question with none holds none

R19 recipes.machineReading: the reading is suggested by the credential of a run, not by a member; the member may reject it; control: a member's own suggest names the member; a world without the test instance refuses
R19 recipes.graded: the question's connection axis is graded B by resolution and the capture axis is not; control: an ungraded leg leaves the connection unrated
R19 recipes.sharedOrigin: the two parts of the partition share their issuer; control: two pages with no issuer share nothing
R19 question `extent_rect` and pdf `fonts`: a decoded PDF (type0 with a ToUnicode map) reads as page units and a leg carries its rect into the record; the default font decodes none
R23 (door): a project's owner reads a draft's review copy through the door; a member with no standing and a caller with no session are given the one dead answer, the same bytes
R23 (door): a member's `reviewcomment` and a list of `drafts` are read as the member's; a grant's secret still opens the one copy for a recipient with no session
R23: a secret-presenting op's request carries neither the secret nor a stamp the caller named, in the address and the body; the digest stays
R23, R4: a member's session at the template doors is stamped viewer and author as the door stamps it; a recipient, and any caller that is no session, carries none
R12, R3: a LOCAL_FACTS op's body keeps the correction's own `source`, drops every stamp a caller names, and its address takes no `source`
R12 (door): the founder's correction of a local fact with its source is accepted by the owner, and the same without a source is refused FACT_VALUE_REFUSED (control)
R23, R4 (door): a member's session at templatereview is stamped, so the owner does not say the call carries nobody
R23 (door): a caller with no secret and no session at a template door is given the one dead answer NO_TEMPLATE_GRANT at 404, as a presented secret no live grant holds is
R17: selftest through the door: the captures bucket unbound answers ok and says the optional storage is off; both bound answers ok; one without the other is the owner's refusal
R17: selftest is a read of the founder and an administrator's session, and the published recipe leaves the pair bound
R7: the translation acts carry `by` and `translations` carries `viewer` as the session's member id, a forged one dropped; a non-session caller carries `class:<cls>`
R7: in a world, a second administrator grants a language and reads `translations` for it; a member holding no grant is refused (control)
storeWorld (fixture): the real store with its producing team recorded by the real act, the door, sign-ins, boot and recipes; two worlds share nothing
R16: real sign-ins: the founder by login; a member by memberadd, enroll and login; admin and capabilities by the real acts; a refused act throws naming the op
R17: the door's families: unknown op, admission, a store route per stamp kind, the sign-in door, a public read, attest, the module arms, the re-made relays, and WORLD_NO_DOOR_ARM
R15: the world's door makes every store request by innerRequest and by no rule of its own: one op of each row, for each kind of caller
R18: bootOf answers the door bound to the member and the session record interface-shell's boot takes
R19: the recipes perform real acts and answer what the acts answered
R20: every declared op is a key of the route map or answered by the world's door; the unreachable set is closed, each with its cause
R17: the binding classes the world's env holds are admitted as the Worker admits them
storeWorld (fixture), R17: the world binds the published plane as plane's Worker does, so R70's case-file sweep builds an edition's case file in a world
